priorTitleScopeReview.reason: The broad Business Administration PhD and Supply Chain research pathway do not themselves match; KEDGE has a named Operations Management and Information Systems academic department, but the saved evidence does not establish this department as the actual host of this PhD pathway.

resolution.reason: The current PhD programme directly links its official doctoral-student directory. Multiple Supply Chain/CESIT doctoral entries explicitly identify Department: MOSI and link the named Operations Management and Information Systems Academic Department. This is direct doctoral departmental affiliation, beyond overlapping faculty membership. The linked department page confirms the full qualifying host title. Retain one Business Administration doctoral opportunity with the Supply Chain research pathway; do not invent a separately awarded Operations doctorate, a student census or disjoint graduate populations.
